Terms of Service

Welcome to HyperAuto Care.

These Terms of Service explain the rules and conditions for using our website and accessing information about our automotive detailing, protection, and vehicle care services.

By visiting our website or contacting HyperAuto Care, you agree to these terms.

Last updated: August 12, 2026

1. Website Use

You may use this website for personal and informational purposes related to our services.

You agree not to:

Use this website for unlawful purposes

Attempt to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to our website

Copy or misuse website content without permission

Provide false information when contacting us

We reserve the right to restrict access to our website if misuse or harmful activity is detected.

2. Services

HyperAuto Care provides professional automotive care services, including:

Vehicle detailing

Interior cleaning

Paint correction

Ceramic coating

Paint protection film installation

Window tint services

Other vehicle appearance and protection services

Service availability, pricing, and completion times may vary depending on:

Vehicle size

Vehicle condition

Service requirements

Current availability

We may inspect a vehicle before confirming the recommended service.

3. Service Estimates and Pricing

Pricing information provided on our website is intended as general guidance.

Final pricing may vary based on the actual condition of the vehicle and the level of work required.

Additional services may be recommended if unexpected conditions are discovered during inspection.

We will communicate any significant changes before additional work is performed.

4. Appointments and Service Availability

Some services may be available without an appointment.

For specialized services such as ceramic coating, paint correction, paint protection film, and window tint, we recommend contacting HyperAuto Care in advance.

Service completion times may vary depending on workload and vehicle requirements.

5. Vehicle Responsibility

Customers are responsible for removing personal belongings from their vehicles before service.

HyperAuto Care is not responsible for personal items left inside vehicles.

Customers should inform our team of any existing vehicle conditions, damage, modifications, or concerns before service begins.

6. Results and Expectations

Automotive detailing and protection services improve vehicle appearance and protection but cannot guarantee the removal of every imperfection.

Results may vary depending on:

Vehicle condition

Previous repairs

Paint quality

Material condition

Environmental exposure

Our team will provide professional recommendations based on the condition of each vehicle.

7. Payments

Payment terms will be communicated before or during service confirmation.

Customers are responsible for completing payment for approved services.

Pricing, promotions, and service availability may change without prior notice.

8. Intellectual Property

All website content, including text, images, graphics, logos, and design elements, belongs to HyperAuto Care or its content providers and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

You may not reproduce, distribute, or use website materials without prior written permission.

9. Third-Party Services

Our website may include links to external websites or services.

HyperAuto Care does not control third-party websites and is not responsible for their content, availability, or policies.

10. Limitation of Liability

HyperAuto Care is not responsible for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use of our website or services.

Our responsibility is limited to the services directly provided and the terms agreed upon with the customer.

11. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time.

Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Your continued use of our website after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us.
